paper_title: Results of a Search for Paraphotons with Intense X-ray Beams at SPring-8
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing chi, dimensionless (as plotted on y-axis)
notes: Light-shining-through-wall paraphoton (hidden U(1) photon) search with X-ray beam at SPring-8. Flat upper limit chi < 8.06e-5 (95% CL) valid for 0.04 eV < m < 26 keV. Encoded as horizontal line over stated validity range. LSW terrestrial bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density. Worst value chi=8.01e-5 at 1.39 eV, final conservative 8.06e-5. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 30)) | Vision: Figure 4 'our experiment' blue curve traced. Text confirms chi < 8.06e-5 (95% C.L.) for 0.04 eV < m < 26 keV; worst value chi_worst=8.01e-5 at 1.39 eV; flat limit ~3.5e-5 for 5 eV to 9 keV. Left steep rise is the LSW oscillation suppression at low mass. Flat region beyond ~60 eV shown dashed but same value, extended to 3e3 eV. Oscillating envelope in 0.05-60 eV region approximated.
